info.name: VMS - Visitor Management System API
info.description:
Complete API collection for automated and manual testing in Postman, Insomnia, or Thunder Client.

Pre-configured with authentication token auto-capture on login, sample payloads, and complete route coverage across all 16 modules.

request.description: Check if backend server is live and connected to MySQL database.
Check whether initial system setup has already been completed.
One-time initial bootstrap: creates organization and initial super_admin account.
Validates email and password. In non-production mode, the 6-digit OTP code is logged in the backend console. Account locks for 15 minutes after 5 consecutive bad passwords.
Verifies the 6-digit OTP code and receives the authentic session JWT token.
Returns currently authenticated user profile with permissions and active role.

item.name: Verify Email OTP + Issue Visitor Token
Global Executive Summary (Super Admin & Global Auditor)

request.description: View login lockouts, bad login attempts, wrong OTPs, and privilege actions across the entire enterprise.
